description: An investment committee chair must decide whether the bank should purchase a secondary participation in a project-finance loan and finalize the exposure size, purchase price, legal transfer condition, compliance controls, and settlement mechanics, with input from sector research, legal, compliance, and loan operations.

shared_context.S1: A selling bank has offered the institution a secondary participation in a project-finance loan with a face amount of $10,000,000 and an indicative purchase price of 92% of face value.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the binding investment committee decision.
shared_context.S3: The loan finances a completed regional water-treatment facility and has made all scheduled payments to date.
shared_context.S4: At the committee's standing pre-trade review, the chair takes a round of updates from credit research, legal, sustainable-finance compliance, and loan operations before finalizing the trade.
shared_context.S5: Under the committee's secondary-participation policy, when credit review identifies a viable revised size and price below the seller's indication, the committee proceeds with a conditional purchase at the stated maximum sound exposure and price ceiling, subject to seller acceptance and closing conditions, rather than recording a decline.

PF1.text: Jonas completed a recovery and cash-flow review this morning using the borrower's updated operating data: the committee's maximum sound exposure is $6,000,000 and the participation should be bought at exactly 88% of face value; his revised note has not yet been circulated.

PF2.text: Elena found in the underlying credit agreement this week that any secondary assignment requires written consent from the administrative agent before settlement; this transfer condition is not in the trade ticket template.

PF3.text: Ravi confirmed in a compliance memo received yesterday that this facility falls within the bank's enhanced sustainable-finance review perimeter, requiring enhanced due diligence and a quarterly environmental-impact certificate; the compliance checklist has not yet been updated.

PF4.text: Tessa confirmed with the custodian this morning that this participation can settle only on T+5 business days into a segregated custody account because the seller's agent requires prefunded delivery; operations has not amended the draft settlement instructions.

acceptance_conditions: The participation must be purchased with a face amount of exactly $6,000,000 at a purchase price of exactly 88% of face value.
Written administrative-agent consent must be required before settlement.
Enhanced sustainable-finance due diligence and a quarterly environmental-impact certificate must both be required.
The trade must settle on T+5 business days into a segregated custody account.

The purchase must be approved and the settlement must include commitments addressing administrative-agent consent, sustainable-finance enhanced due diligence and quarterly environmental certification, and T+5 settlement into a segregated custody account.

content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] in ['administrative agent', 'administrative_agent', 'legal', 'Elena'] and ('consent' in c['detail'] or 'assignment' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] in ['sustainable-finance compliance', 'sustainable_finance_compliance', 'Ravi'] and ('enhanced due diligence' in c['detail'] or 'environmental-impact certificate' in c['detail'] or 'quarterly environmental' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['target'] in ['loan operations', 'loan_operations', 'Tessa'] and ('T+5' in c['detail'] or 'segregated custody' in c['detail'] or 'settlement instructions' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The public offer supports buying the full $10,000,000 at 92%, while PF1 supplies the exact revised purchase terms of $6,000,000 at 88%; under shared policy S5, those stated maximums become the required conditional purchase rather than a reason to decline.

The draft trade ticket has no transfer condition, while PF2 changes agent_consent_required to true and adds a commitment directed to legal or the administrative agent to obtain written consent before settlement.

The public facts contain no special sustainable-finance controls, while PF3 changes both compliance flags to true and adds a commitment directed to Ravi or sustainable-finance compliance for enhanced review and quarterly certification.

The public facts contain no confirmed settlement mechanics, while PF4 changes settlement_days to exactly 5, changes settlement_account_type to 'segregated custody account', and adds a commitment directed to Tessa or loan operations for the amended prefunded settlement instructions.
